description: This file defines the AuthRepository class for handling authentication data operations, including login, logout, and retrieving the current user, utilizing remote API and local preferences storage.

classes.name: AuthRepository
classes.description: Repository class that manages user authentication data, including login, logout, and retrieving the current user profile.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login by calling the remote auth API, stores the token and user profile in local preferences, and returns a User object.

methods.name: token
methods.description: Getter that retrieves the stored authentication token.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears the stored token and user profile from local preferences to log out the user.

methods.name: currentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current user profile from local preferences if available, otherwise returns null.
